_about: Chapter names for the reader, all 66 books. Researcher: Claude, 2026-10-13. Draft for Codex to load; not a records batch. Keys are book name as in data/books.json, then chapter number.
_style: Title case: capitalise all major words.
Use the name the chapter is most widely known by where it has one (The Fall of Man, The Sacrifice of Isaac, Jacob’s Ladder), even where that name is an interpretation (owner decision, 2026-10-13).
Where a chapter has no settled name, name its main event or subject in plain words.
Where a chapter has more than one significant event, name each, in the order they occur, separated by a semicolon; three at most (owner decision, 2026-10-13).
Use the KJV’s forms of names and its vocabulary (Abram until Genesis 17, Butler not Cupbearer).
